static_traits.name: Zhang Cheng
static_traits.family_status: Living with the husband and two children
static_traits.social_status: Stable relationships with the child and husband; having one close friend, but not yet sharing the sense of worthlessness with her; tending to self-isolate when feeling inadequate
static_traits.medical_history: No history of similar psychological problems yet; no previous psychological counseling/treatment experience; no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to describe automatic thoughts and emotional experiences concretely, high cooperativeness; speech pace and thinking logic not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: After missing an episode of her favorite show <Face Off> because she was busy caring for the child, she began frequently applying the self-labels 'useless' and 'not good enough'; treating small mistakes (like missing a TV show, not finishing housework, dinner not being on time) as total failure, appearing almost daily recently and worsening, affecting self-esteem and daily life.
basic_info.core_demands: I realize that these negative thoughts and feelings are affecting my daily life and self-worth, so I seek support in counseling.

special_situations.event: Missed an episode of 'Face Off' because of being busy caring for the children
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot even do such a small thing, it proves I am useless
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to better organize my schedule, set reminders, or record programs to avoid missing again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I cannot even remember such a simple thing; I am a useless person.

special_situations.event: Not finishing the day's household chores
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If housework is not all finished, it means I am a failure as a 'full-time mother'
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubles down on time management and task prioritization, striving to catch up on all housework
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I cannot even finish housework; I am a failure.

special_situations.event: Dinner not yet ready on time
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If dinner is not ready on time, I am not a competent parent
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Arranges and optimizes the family schedule more strictly, trying to set more reminders
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I should manage things better; otherwise I am not a competent parent.

special_situations.event: Feelings of worthlessness arise almost daily when missing small tasks or leisure
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If any small task is not completed, it means I am an utter failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: When feeling inadequate, Reduced socializing and self-isolation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Every small mistake makes me feel utterly worthless.

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be seen as a competent and valuable caregiver (parental role), gaining stable self-esteem and recognition
core_conflict.fear: Afraid of being negated as a failure over small mistakes, thereby losing my sense of worth
defense_goal: Avoiding outside evaluation and maintaining a sense of safety by internalizing strict 'should' standards and self-isolation

object_relations.object_representation: Harsh judge (internalized role expectations and standards)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about or facing concrete mistakes such as not yet finished small tasks or missed shows
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Equates one mistake with overall failure, tying role value completely to perfect performance
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Maintain a gentle, accepting tone, name their internalized standards of 'should', invite exploration of the sources and functions of these rules; encourage distinguishing feelings from facts, and balance the self-evaluation with concrete evidence.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: Moments of reaching out to others or preparing to share feelings when feeling 'not good enough'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing that contact will expose my own incompetence and failures, thus increasing shame and the risk of being negated
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: In a supportive, non-judgmental tone, Reinforcement their self-care and boundary awareness; use gentle reflection and normalization, inviting low-risk sharing (e.g., practicing first with the counselor or a trusted friend).

manifestations: Frequently labeling myself 'useless', seeing a single mistake as total failure
Reduced enjoyment of active pursuits (running, cooking)
Tending to self-isolate when feeling inadequate
Having close friends but not yet sharing feelings of worthlessness and distress
outcomes: Negative self-evaluations receive no correction or support

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Frequently has the self-demand 'I should manage better'
Using role expectations (the 'Full-time mother' standard) as the basis for judging self-worth

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to do some behavior toward other people or things, or gives up seeking help outwardly, instead doing it to themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Choosing self-isolation over seeking support when feeling inadequate
Digests stress and self-blame inwardly rather than expressing them outwardly

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Excessive self-criticism over small mistakes and labeling myself 'useless'
Worrying about exposing inadequacy and sharing less with others

positive_force: Stable relationships with husband and children, with basic family support
Has one close friend as a potential support resource
Interested in running and cooking, with recoverable positive activities
Actively seeks psychological counseling, positive attitude
Willing to try concrete strategies such as time management, setting reminders, and recording programs
negative_force: Overgeneralization, mental filtering, personalization, and rigid 'should' statements leading to self-labeling
Tending to self-isolate when feeling inadequate, reducing external correction and support
Overly ties self-worth to completion of small tasks
Emotional reasoning and somatic tension worsen the sense of discomfort

target_behavior.behavior: Labeling myself 'useless' and 'failure' when small mistakes occur, with markedly low mood
antecedent: Dinner not yet ready on time
target_behavior.core_reason: Tightly binding self-worth to the performance of perfectly fulfilling small tasks, driven by overgeneralization, mental filtering, and 'should' beliefs
target_behavior.function: Escapes being judged and shame; maintains a sense of control over the situation
target_behavior.consequence: Lowered self-esteem, reduced enjoyment of positive activities, overall mood and Decreased life satisfaction

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids socializing and sharing when feeling inadequate (self-isolation)
antecedent: After Self-denial and feelings of worthlessness arise
Moments of seeing myself as 'a failure/not competent'
target_behavior.core_reason: Fearing exposure of 'incompetence' and being negated, turning shame and Anxiety inward
target_behavior.function: Short-term reduction of external judgment and interpersonal discomfort
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased support, deepening Loneliness and Negative self-evaluation, problems maintained and worsened

target_behavior.behavior: Somatic tension and a knotted stomach when negative events trigger
antecedent: After realizing a show was missed or tasks not yet completed
When 'I am useless' Automatic thoughts arise
target_behavior.core_reason: Stress reactions caused by emotional reasoning and high arousal
target_behavior.consequence: Physical discomfort intensifies subjective suffering, further Reinforcement negative cognitions and avoidance
